class.name: OcgXcafdocGraphnode
class.brief_description: This attribute allow user multirelation tree of labels. This GraphNode is experimental Graph that not control looping and redundance. Attribute containing sequence of father's and child's labels. Provide create and work with Graph in XCAFDocument.
class.description: ! This attribute allow user multirelation tree of labels. ! This GraphNode is experimental Graph that not control looping and redundance. ! Attribute containing sequence of father's and child's labels. ! Provide create and work with Graph in XCAFDocument.

method.name: SetFather
method.description: Set GraphNode <F> as father of me and returns index of <F> in Sequence that containing Fathers GraphNodes. return index of <F> from GraphNodeSequnece

method.name: SetChild
method.description: Set GraphNode <Ch> as child of me and returns index of <Ch> in Sequence that containing Children GraphNodes. return index of <Ch> from GraphNodeSequnece

method.name: UnSetFather_1
method.description: Remove <F> from Fathers GraphNodeSequence. and remove link between father and child.

method.name: UnSetFather_2
method.description: Remove Father GraphNode by index from Fathers GraphNodeSequence. and remove link between father and child.

method.name: UnSetChild_1
method.description: Remove <Ch> from GraphNodeSequence. and remove link between father and child.

method.name: UnSetChild_2
method.description: Remove Child GraphNode by index from Children GraphNodeSequence. and remove link between father and child.

method.name: GetFather
method.description: Return GraphNode by index from GraphNodeSequence.

method.name: GetChild
method.description: Return GraphNode by index from GraphNodeSequence.

method.name: FatherIndex
method.description: Return index of <F>, or zero if there is no such Graphnode.

method.name: ChildIndex
method.description: Return index of <Ch>, or zero if there is no such Graphnode.

method.name: IsFather
method.description: returns TRUE if <me> is father of <Ch>.

method.name: IsChild
method.description: returns TRUE if <me> is child of <F>.

method.name: NbFathers
method.description: return Number of Fathers GraphNodes.

method.name: NbChildren
method.description: return Number of Childrens GraphNodes. Implementation of Attribute methods: ===================================

method.name: ID
method.description: Returns the Graph ID (default or explicit one depending on the Set method used).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Find
method.description: class methods working on the node ================================= Shortcut to search a Graph node attribute with default GraphID. Returns true if found.

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Finds or Creates a GraphNode attribute on the label <L> with the default Graph ID, returned by the method <GetDefaultGraphID>. Returns the created/found GraphNode attribute.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Finds or Creates a GraphNode attribute on the label <L>, with an explicit tree ID. <ExplicitGraphID> is the ID returned by <TDF_Attribute::ID> method. Returns the found/created GraphNode attribute.

method.name: GetDefaultGraphID
method.description: returns a default Graph ID. this ID is used by the <Set> method without explicit tree ID. Instance methods: ================
